Vivian Chen: Morning! I'm Vivian — excited to join Product Design. Quick setup Qs: MDM profile shows "Redwood Corp" but my laptop won't connect to VPN. Anyone on VPN/setup duty? Also a tiny intro: I brew kombucha and used to play competitive ultimate frisbee. :wave:

Courtney Li: hey viv! welcome :tada: I'm your buddy. DM me your laptop model and I'll loop infra. Also we usually play 2 truths and a lie in these threads — want to do that?

Samir Patel: Hi Vivian — welcome aboard! Your equipment should be in Parcel #42 per shipping notice. If VPN error persists, try reinstalling the MDM profile (mac): `sudo profiles remove -identifier com.redwood.mdm && sudo profiles install /tmp/redwood.mobileconfig`. If you're on Win, ping me and I can send the MSI.

Rajiv Shah: also check DNS and certs — on mac you can run `scutil --dns` and `sudo dscacheutil -flushcache`. If you paste the exact error we can triage. TLS/cert messages usually mean the CA didn't get pushed.

Platform Onboard Bot: New hire checklist updated — Vivian Chen added. Buddy: Courtney Li. Hardware: MacBook Pro 14 (configured). Orientation: 10:30am PT tomorrow.

Vivian Chen: Thanks! Laptop is MacBook Pro 14 (M2). Error is "VPN service failed to start" — I'll DM the logs. Also ok here's 2 truths and a lie: 1) I brewed kombucha for 4 years. 2) I once deployed a tiny NFT contract called BrokenBakery. 3) I can do a backwards ollie on a skateboard. Guess away :grin:

Courtney Li: My guess is #2 is the lie. Also FYI we have a Friday lunch lottery where you can win local tacos. :taco:

Ryan Gomez: Welcome! I'm on infra — will take a look at VPN logs when you DM. If you can run `sudo tail -n 200 /var/log/vpn.log` and paste the relevant snippet that helps.

Samir Patel: For welcome box preferences, reply with "stickers" or "no stickers" and any keyboard layout (US/ISO). We'll send it out this week.

Vivian Chen: stickers please 🙏 Keyboard: US. Sent you the logs, Ryan — shows `Auth failed: TLS handshake`.

Courtney Li: got the DM, thanks. If it's TLS handshake we'll check CA push and MDM cert chain. Also please post your frisbee team pic sometime — we have a very competitive slack frisbee thread. :frisbee:

Rajiv Shah: TLS handshake makes sense if the CA cert didn't install. Samir, can you confirm the MDM pushed the enterprise CA? If not, I'll trigger a manual cert push to Viv's device.

Platform Onboard Bot: Reminder: orientation invite (10:30am PT) sent to Vivian Chen. New hire survey will arrive after orientation.

Vivian Chen: Amazing, thank you all! Looking forward to orientation and meeting y'all. Also excited to bring some kombucha to the office someday :smile:
